Crop Management Guideधान (Dhan)

Rice / Paddy Protection Plan

Rice paddies thrive under intensive water management, which also creates favorable conditions for devastating fungal pathogens like Sheath Blight and stubborn grass weeds. Systematic post-emergence weed control and timely systemic protection are crucial for maximum grain filling.

Key Crop Growth Stages:
1. Nursery & Transplanting2. Tillering & Panicle Initiation3. Flowering & Milking4. Grain Maturity & Harvest
Target Challenges

Major Rice / Paddy Pests, Diseases & Weeds

Identified agronomic threats that cause economic threshold damage during Rice / Paddy cultivation.

Pest

Yellow Stem Borer & Leaf Folder

Larvae cause dead hearts at vegetative stage and white heads at panicle stage.

Recommended Formulation(s):
RIDONA →
Pest

Brown Plant Hopper (BPH) & Green Leafhopper

Sucks plant sap causing hopper burn patches in dense paddy fields.

Recommended Formulation(s):
SHIMDOR →
Disease

Sheath Blight & Fungal Diseases

Oval lesions on leaf sheaths leading to poor panicle emergence.

Recommended Formulation(s):
HAITOR →
Weed

Barnyard Grass (Echinochloa) & Sedges

Mimics young rice plants and severely reduces tillering capacity.

Recommended Formulation(s):
VOLVO →

Field Recommendations for Rice / Paddy Growers

  • Apply selective post-emergence herbicide at 2-4 weed leaf stage.
  • Scout for yellow stem borer dead hearts during tillering.
  • Apply protective fungicide at initiation of sheath blight symptoms.
  • Optimize drainage prior to harvesting to prevent grain lodging.
